archetypes.name: dyn-evidence-gate
archetypes.rationale: The change adds provenance gating for model-authored triage rows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the analyze-bugs triage evidence-token gate. Check whether any Task prompt, manifest, batch JSONL, or legacy ledger path can bypass a real Read of the bundle markdown. Verify that rejected rows fail closed without accepting fabricated NEEDS_DEEP output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
